title: Read the Optimization Candidates record across Show latest in mounted cases

intentCoverage.report:
# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-413#optimization-candidates-revision-cases

**Verdict: Caught.**

- **Story:** SEED-413#optimization-candidates-revision-cases (`.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#optimization-candidates-revision-cases`, plan `.planning/slice-plans/729-optimization-candidates-revision-cases/PLAN.md`).
- **Revision:** 19c49c7a05064c36694205ebf2dc2ea35c60e9cb.
- **Promise:** When a newer revision is offered, Optimization Candidates stays chosen. Its record still reads `Recorded at revision <before>` with the old entry. It moves to the new revision only on **Show latest**.

## Fault
I used the caller's suggested fault after checking it against the code. The record now reads the offered (observed) revision as soon as it is offered. The fault touches only the record. The rest of the reading, including the files browser, stays at the shown revision, and the revision notice is unchanged.
- `dashboard/src/useShownIntentLocations.tsx`: also returns `offeredRevision: observed`.
- `dashboard/src/IntentPage.tsx`: passes `candidatesRevision={shown.offeredRevision ?? shownRevision}` to `IntentBrowser`.
- `dashboard/src/IntentBrowser.tsx`: gives `IntentCandidatesPanel` `revision={candidatesRevision ?? revision}`.
Fixtures and assertions were left unchanged. The two faults the execution already tried (pinning the record at the first revision, and stale guards that are always true) were not repeated.

## Evidence
- **Scratch checkout:** a detached worktree at the revision under the job tmp directory, with its own `npm ci` and Node v24.21.0 (matches `.node-version`). It was clean before the probe.
- **Command:** `caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- intent/intent-candidates-revision`.
- **Baseline:** all 3 tests in `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-candidates-revision.spec.ts` passed, including the selected case at line 83. Vitest duration 3.48s.
- **Faulted run:** 1 failed and 2 passed, duration 3.31s.
  - **Wrong behavior, observed independently:** a temporary log in `IntentCandidatesRecord`'s read effect printed `record reads at e9e9` in the line-83 case. That read started when the revision was offered, before **Show latest**. The rendered record also showed `Recorded at revision e9e9e9e … launch-records-page-clock` while the notice was still showing.
  - **What caught it:** `candidates.isRecordedAt(before)` at spec line 94, the first assertion after `offerRevision(after)` and `intentRevisionNotice().isShownOnce()`. The check is the `expect.poll(...).toContain("Recorded at revision …")` in `dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-candidates-page.ts:28-33`. It expected `Recorded at revision abababa (abab…)` and received `Recorded at revision e9e9e9e (e9e9…)`.
  - The other two cases still passed. That is expected, because they assert only after **Show latest**, where the faulted and correct revisions are the same.
- **Restoration:** `git checkout -- dashboard/src` removed the fault and the witness log. `git status --short --untracked-files=all` then showed 0 entries, and HEAD was still 19c49c7a0. The same command passed 3/3 again, duration 2.21s. I then removed the scratch worktree with `git worktree remove --force`, needed for the ignored `node_modules` and test results; `git worktree list` no longer lists it.

**Claim limit:** this covers only the mounted path in the line-83 case: Optimization Candidates chosen, the revision offered by rerender, and the check before **Show latest**. It makes no claim about the page's own check schedule, which the auto-refresh journeys cover.

**Next proof action:** none needed for this fault. The maintained assertion catches it.
**Prior disposition:** this matches the plan's preserved assertion "the record's revision line, and the old entry before **Show latest**". It is a recognition of existing proof, not a new repair decision.

## Cost
- **Test runtime (measured, Vitest "Duration"):** baseline 3.48s, faulted 3.31s, restored 2.21s, so 9.0s in total. This excludes the `npm ci` in the scratch checkout, which was not timed separately.
- **Human effort:** not available. No human took part during the probe.
- **Agent effort:** not available. I have no separate measure of tokens or active time, and the elapsed time below includes waiting.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 113541 ms (measured), from 1795163877000 to 1795163990541 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 19c49c7a05064c36694205ebf2dc2ea35c60e9cb: Caught by `isRecordedAt(before)` in the stays-chosen case; no follow-up.
